summary: Variance decomposition: invariant features (lat/lon/month) explain only R²=0.002 of gridded albedo variance, while cloud variables explain R²=0.44. This CHALLENGES H002 in the linear regime — at the grid-cell level, spatial/temporal invariants are weak predictors. However, clouds dominate (supports H001). Stable across 2000-2012 and 2013-2025 subsets.
